name: Kanno Riri
source:
A student at Nishinazaka Gakuen, Class 3-7. Riri is a beautiful girl who looks like a model and has excellent grades. Her personality is modest and gentle, and she is also popular at her school.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lunasys.info/cate_lunasystem/product]official website[/url].]
